caseNameFull: United States v. McNinch, doing business as Home Comport Co.
attorneys: A. C. Epps and Charles W. Laughlin for Cato Bros., Inc., et al., respondents.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 355 U. S. 808, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. The motion to remove this case from the summary calendar is granted and a total of one hour and a half allowed for oral argument.
